title: Attachment
description: A Capture's reference to one Blob, as the Hub sends it in the changes feed. There is no processing status here (D1). Open: clients ignore members they do not know.

capture_id.description: Filled by the Hub from the Capture the Attachment came in with.

role.description: Known roles are the examples; a newer Hub may send others, which a client keeps but does not interpret. capture.commit takes only the known ones.

seq.description: Order of an audio segment within its recording.

original_filename.description: File name as the user saw it, NFC.

original_filename_raw.description: The file name exactly as received, present only when it is not already NFC (U2, rule raw_form).

captured_at_precision.description: low for times taken from EXIF or other sources without a reliable clock (D15).

consistency.description: Cross-member rules shared by the feed shape and the commit input.
